ariaLabel: Open help: All Assets list and permissions

sections.heading: Admin and IT Ops
bullets: You see the full asset catalog. Search by tag, model, manufacturer, or holder; filter by inventory status and category; optionally hide rows where the current holder is ERP-inactive. Use Refresh to reload the grid.

Click a row to open that asset’s detail page. In Actions: View QR opens a dialog (Download saves the PNG); Edit goes to the same detail page; Delete moves the asset to the Recycle Bin after you confirm.
In the QR dialog, IT Ops users also get Regenerate QR if a code must be rebuilt from the server.

sections.heading: Employee
bullets: You only see assets currently assigned to you—the list is scoped to your profile. Filters still apply within that list.
View QR, Edit, and Delete are not available in this grid for your role; open a row to read details, or contact an administrator for changes.
